screen: Normalized Shannon entropy of primary-category counts among unique provided Overture places; five-fold cross-fit distinctness screen; unregistered
definition: For each official tract with at least 10 unique assigned nonnull Overture place IDs, count each ID once by its nonnull categories.primary value. Compute H/log(75) exactly as preregistered; the 75 is the fixed normalizer, not a category filter. Records with null primary contribute to unique-place support but not category frequencies; entropy remains null if fewer than 10 places or no usable primary category. Any computed value above 1 is retained as a boundedness-gate failure, never clipped.

method.inputs: Read only Overture id, categories.primary, and bbox; use bbox center assignment with the existing official ACS GEOID/geometry tract index. No Overture geometry, alternate category, names, sources, confidence, or other fields are read.
method.unique_places: Deduplicate nonnull Overture IDs within region; conflicting duplicate ID tract/category assignments are errors.
method.entropy: Shannon entropy -sum(p log p)/log(75), using every observed nonnull provided primary category; values are not clipped, and any value above 1 fails the requested boundedness gate.
method.cross_fit: Five deterministic region-local GEOID folds; OLS with intercept, frozen Mx4 F and S1 lagged Mx4 F is trained on four folds and predicts the held-out fold. No labels, tuning, or imputation.
method.variance_ratio: Pooled population variance (ddof=0) of held-out residuals divided by entropy variance on the same complete-case support.
method.correlation: Pooled Pearson r between held-out residual and each frozen predictor.

interpretation: The entropy screen fails at least one preregistered support or distinctness gate; do not integrate and retain only as an audit output.
